title: I Pulled Out the Whole Stone. (Part 1)
summary: Rowan takes his dad's turn at the sword, wakes a stone king and learns why twenty years of failed pulls mattered.
frame_0: Seen from behind, Rowan faces a crowned, gold-eyed stone king in the cracked town square. A sword rises from the giant's crown, the human king watches from the left, and the title sits against the blue sky.
package_differences: The specified watermark PNG was unavailable. Jake approved the typeset @idlemerchantrng corner handle.
